dogecoin.text: Crypto queens, who's serving up a bigger drop-the-mic moment today - Elton John's glittery piano antics or the Dogecoin pups' overnight rampage to a new all-time high? Stay fabulous, and always keep your coins close!

Darling, the queens of crypto are slaying the market today! I can feel the Bitcoin bear looking rather tired, can't you, girls? With all the sparkle and shine in the digital realm, it's no wonder Dogecoin is having its moment to shine.
